title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
description: Final Fantasy VII Remake is a role-playing video game developed and published by Square Enix. It is a reimagining of the original Final Fantasy VII, featuring updated graphics, real-time combat, and an expanded storyline.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
description: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt is an action role-playing game developed by CD Projekt Red. It features an open world, a rich narrative, and complex characters, allowing players to make choices that affect the game's outcome.

title: Persona 5
description: Persona 5 is a Japanese role-playing game developed by Atlus. It follows a group of high school students who lead double lives as Phantom Thieves, exploring dungeons and battling supernatural enemies.

title: Dragon Quest XI: Echoes of an Elusive Age
description: Dragon Quest XI: Echoes of an Elusive Age is a role-playing game developed and published by Square Enix. It features turn-based combat, a vast world to explore, and a compelling story.

title: Xenoblade Chronicles 2
description: Xenoblade Chronicles 2 is an action role-playing game developed by Monolith Soft and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo Switch. It features a vast open world, real-time combat, and a deep narrative.

title: Octopath Traveler
description: Octopath Traveler is a role-playing game developed by Square Enix. It features eight unique characters, each with their own story and abilities, and utilizes a turn-based combat system.

title: Tales of Arise
description: Tales of Arise is an action role-playing game developed and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment. It features a dynamic combat system, a rich story, and beautifully designed environments.

title: Ni no Kuni II: Revenant Kingdom
description: Ni no Kuni II: Revenant Kingdom is a role-playing game developed by Level-5. It features a charming story, real-time combat, and a vibrant world filled with unique characters and creatures.

title: Fire Emblem: Three Houses
description: Fire Emblem: Three Houses is a tactical role-playing game developed by Intelligent Systems and Koei Tecmo. It features turn-based battles, character development, and a branching storyline based on player choices.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel IV
description: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel IV is a role-playing game developed by Nihon Falcom. It continues the story of the Erebonian Empire, featuring turn-based combat and a deep narrative.

title: Yakuza: Like a Dragon
description: Yakuza: Like a Dragon is a role-playing game developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio. It features turn-based combat, a new protagonist, and a story that explores the criminal underworld of Japan.

title: Bravely Default II
description: Bravely Default II is a role-playing game developed by Claytechworks and published by Square Enix. It features turn-based combat, a job system, and a story that follows four heroes on a quest to save their world.

title: Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin
description: Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin is a role-playing game developed by Capcom. It features turn-based combat, monster collecting, and a story that follows a young Rider on a quest to save the world from an ancient threat.

title: Dragon Age: Inquisition
description: Dragon Age: Inquisition is a role-playing game developed by BioWare. It features an open world, tactical combat, and a story that follows the Inquisitor as they seek to restore order to a world in turmoil.

title: Divinity: Original Sin 2
description: Divinity: Original Sin 2 is a role-playing game developed by Larian Studios. It features turn-based combat, a rich narrative, and a world that reacts to player choices, allowing for multiple paths and endings.

title: Dark Souls III
description: Dark Souls III is an action role-playing game developed by FromSoftware. It features challenging combat, intricate level design, and a dark fantasy world filled with lore and secrets.

title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim
description: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim is an open-world role-playing game developed by Bethesda Game Studios. It features a vast world to explore, a rich narrative, and a variety of quests and activities.

title: Mass Effect Legendary Edition
description: Mass Effect Legendary Edition is a remastered collection of the Mass Effect trilogy developed by BioWare. It features updated graphics, improved gameplay mechanics, and a cohesive narrative experience.

title: Horizon Zero Dawn
description: Horizon Zero Dawn is an action role-playing game developed by Guerrilla Games. It features a post-apocalyptic world inhabited by robotic creatures, and players take on the role of Aloy, a skilled hunter and archer.

title: Cyberpunk 2077
description: Cyberpunk 2077 is an open-world role-playing game developed by CD Projekt Red. It features a futuristic city, a branching narrative, and a variety of gameplay mechanics including combat, hacking, and dialogue choices.
